Dish: Sweet Potato & Apple Breakfast Muffins with cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg, cloves, sweet potato puree, yogurt, diced apples & maple syrup
Instructions: Warm in the oven at 325°F for 8–10 minutes, or microwave for 20–30 seconds. Enjoy at room temperature as well.

Dish: Peanut Butter Breakfast Cookies with peanut butter, vanilla, ground flax seed, oats, flour, mini chocolate chips, eggs & brown sugar
Instructions: No reheating needed — enjoy at room temperature, or warm in the microwave for 15–20 seconds if desired.

Dish: Walnut Maple Granola with oats, walnuts, tahini, maple syrup, ground flax seed, pumpkin seeds, sunflower seeds, hemp seeds & cinnamon
Instructions: No reheating needed — serve at room temperature. Enjoy with milk, yogurt, or on its own as a snack.

Dish: Egg Muffin Cups with broccoli onion red pepper & cheese
Instructions: Warm in the oven at 325°F for 8–10 minutes, or microwave for 30–45 seconds.

Dish: Classic Hummus with chickpeas tahini lemon garlic & cumin
Instructions: No reheating needed — serve at room temperature or chilled. Drizzle with olive oil before serving if desired.

Dish: Baba Ganoush with eggplant tahini garlic cumin & lemon
Instructions: No reheating needed — serve at room temperature or chilled. Drizzle with olive oil and a sprinkle of parsley if desired.

Dish: Mushroom Barley Soup with cremini & shiitake mushrooms, onion, carrots, celery, garlic, bay leaves, thyme, parsley, miso & pearl barley
Instructions: Pour into a saucepan over medium heat. Stir occasionally and heat for 8–10 minutes until warmed through. Add a splash of broth or water if the barley has thickened the soup.

Dish: Split Pea & Ham Soup with onion carrots celery cumin thyme & grated Parmesan
Instructions: Pour into a saucepan over medium-low heat. Stir frequently — split pea soup thickens as it sits, so add a splash of broth or water to reach your preferred consistency. Heat for 8–10 minutes until warmed through.

Dish: Coconut Shrimp & Sweet Potato Fries
Instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F. Spread shrimp and fries on a baking sheet and bake uncovered for 10–12 minutes until crispy and heated through. Do not cover — foil will steam and soften the coating. Reheat green beans in the microwave for 1–2 minutes or warm in the oven alongside for the last 5 minutes.

Dish: Beef Sliders with Roasted Baby Potatoes
Instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Place sliders in an oven-safe dish, cover loosely with foil, and bake for 12–15 minutes. Reheat potatoes on a baking sheet uncovered at 400°F for 8–10 minutes to re-crisp. Reheat green beans in the microwave for 1–2 minutes.

Dish: Baked Rosemary Chicken Meatballs with Tomato Orzo
Instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Place meatballs and orzo in an oven-safe dish, cover with foil, and bake for 15–18 minutes until heated through. Add a splash of water or broth to the orzo if needed before covering. Reheat green beans in the microwave for 1–2 minutes.

Dish: Beef & Cheese Quesadillas
Instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F. Place quesadillas on a baking sheet and bake for 8–10 minutes, flipping halfway, until crispy and heated through. Alternatively, heat in a dry skillet over medium heat for 2–3 minutes per side. Reheat green beans in the microwave for 1–2 minutes.

Dish: Korean Beef Power Bowl with kimchi, shredded red cabbage, avocado & sriracha mayo over farro
Instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Place beef and farro in an oven-safe dish, cover with foil, and bake for 15–18 minutes. Serve with kimchi, shredded red cabbage, avocado & sriracha mayo on the side (cold, no reheat needed).

Dish: Miso Salmon Bowl with miso glazed salmon, roasted shiitake mushrooms, edamame, avocado, shredded red cabbage over jasmine rice & a savory miso dressing
Instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Place salmon on a baking sheet and cover loosely with foil. Warm for 10–12 minutes. Reheat jasmine rice and shiitake mushrooms in the microwave for 1–2 minutes. Serve edamame, avocado, shredded red cabbage & miso dressing cold on the side.

Dish: Kale, Roasted Butternut Squash & Apple Salad with red onion, feta, pecans & a maple apple cider vinaigrette
Instructions: No reheating needed — serve at room temperature or slightly warm. The squash can be gently warmed in the microwave for 30–45 seconds if desired. Dress with maple apple cider vinaigrette just before serving.

Dish: Cauliflower Sweet Potato Couscous Salad with roasted cauliflower, sweet potato, chickpeas, pumpkin seeds, parsley, mint, dill, smoked paprika & pearl couscous with a smoked paprika lemon tahini dressing
Instructions: No reheating needed — serve at room temperature. The roasted vegetables can be gently warmed in the microwave for 30–45 seconds if desired. Dress with smoked paprika lemon tahini dressing just before serving.

Dish: Spicy Shrimp & Cauliflower Mash with garlicky kale
Instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Place shrimp in an oven-safe dish, cover with foil, and bake for 10–12 minutes until heated through. Reheat cauliflower mash in the microwave with a damp paper towel on top for 1–2 minutes, stirring halfway. Reheat garlicky kale in the microwave for 1 minute or warm in a skillet over medium heat for 2–3 minutes.

Dish: White Bean, Spinach & Turkey Stuffed Peppers with orzo, garlic, basil, tomato, oregano, onion, beans, Parmesan, spinach & mozzarella
Instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F. Place peppers in an oven-safe dish, cover with foil, and bake for 20–22 minutes. Remove foil for the last 3–4 minutes to melt and re-bubble the mozzarella on top.

Dish: Thai Inspired Coconut Curry Chicken Meatballs with red curry, ginger, garlic, lime, coconut milk, onion, cilantro & red pepper over jasmine rice
Instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Place meatballs and sauce in an oven-safe dish, cover with foil, and bake for 15–18 minutes. Reheat jasmine rice separately in the microwave with a damp paper towel on top for 1–2 minutes.

Dish: Gochujang Marinated Skirt Steak & Roasted Baby Potatoes with steamed broccoli
Instructions: Preheat oven to 275°F. Place steak on a baking sheet, cover loosely with foil, and warm for 10–12 minutes — low and slow keeps it juicy. For a quick sear, finish in a hot skillet for 30 seconds per side. Reheat potatoes on a separate baking sheet at 400°F for 8–10 minutes uncovered to re-crisp. Reheat broccoli in the microwave for 1–2 minutes.

Dish: Chili Soy Mushroom Meatballs with ginger, scallion rice, cremini & shiitake mushrooms, garlic, chickpeas, egg, cilantro, scallion, liquid aminos & sesame oil
Instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Place meatballs in an oven-safe dish, cover with foil, and bake for 15–18 minutes until heated through. Reheat scallion rice separately in the microwave with a damp paper towel on top for 1–2 minutes.
